$comment: GENERATED by tests/gen_proto_json.c from src/proto.h and src/lib/uictl.h. Do not edit; run `make proto.json`. tests/test_mlib_proto_json.py fails if this file and the generator disagree.

transport.peer_auth: SO_PEERCRED; the peer uid must equal the daemon's

fields.name: version
fields.note: pinned to the negotiated version after HELLO

fields.name: source_tag
fields.note: ADVISORY, audit log only; never an input to a decision

fields.name: payload_len
fields.note: bytes after the header; MUST NOT exceed max_payload

response.comment: the request's header echoed with payload_len rewritten, then u16 result, then opcode-specific data; response data grows append-only and a client must ignore a tail it does not understand

fields.name: opcode_bitmap
fields.note: bit N set means opcode N is implemented; the ONLY correct feature test

fields.name: daemon_version
fields.note: informational; branching on it is feature-sniffing

fields.name: reconnect_max_tries
fields.note: 0 = unbounded; only meaningful when mode is backoff

opcodes.name: PING
opcodes.summary: Liveness probe. Exempt from the handshake and from the rate limit.

opcodes.name: MOVE_ABS
opcodes.summary: Move the pointer to an absolute position in device units.

opcodes.name: HELLO
opcodes.summary: Mandatory handshake. Negotiates the protocol version and names the client. One per connection.

fields.name: proto_min
fields.note: lowest protocol version this client speaks

fields.name: proto_max
fields.note: highest protocol version this client speaks

opcodes.name: KEY_TAP
opcodes.summary: Press and release one key in a single request.

fields.name: keycode
fields.note: Linux keycode, 1..767; the daemon range-checks and policy-checks it

opcodes.name: KEY_SEQUENCE
opcodes.summary: Several key transitions applied atomically under one report. Must be self-balancing: every press has its release inside the same request.

opcodes.name: KEY_DOWN
opcodes.summary: Hold a key down across later requests. The daemon releases it when the connection ends, or after 30 seconds.

fields.name: keycode
fields.note: Linux keycode, 1..767; the daemon range-checks and policy-checks it

opcodes.name: KEY_UP
opcodes.summary: Release a held key. Never refused for a policy reason, never rate-charged, never confirmed.

fields.name: keycode
fields.note: Linux keycode, 1..767; the daemon range-checks and policy-checks it

opcodes.name: CONFIRM_SUBSCRIBE
opcodes.summary: Become the confirmer. Requires the confirmer role in the local registry; one at a time.

opcodes.name: CONFIRM_REQUEST
opcodes.summary: A prompt for a human, pushed to the subscribed confirmer. The only unsolicited frame in the protocol.

fields.name: token
fields.note: the daemon's handle on the parked request; echo it back

fields.name: keycode
fields.note: the key, or 0 where not applicable

fields.name: client_name
fields.note: what the requester said at HELLO; self-asserted

opcodes.name: CONFIRM_DECIDE
opcodes.summary: The confirmer's answer to a prompt.

fields.name: token
fields.note: echoed from the prompt; a stale token is refused

opcodes.name: BUTTON
opcodes.summary: Press or release one pointer button. A release is never confirmed and never rate-charged.

opcodes.name: MOVE_REL
opcodes.summary: Nudge the pointer by a relative delta in device units.

fields.name: dx
fields.note: device units; not scaled by anything

fields.name: dy
fields.note: device units; not scaled by anything

opcodes.name: BATCH
opcodes.summary: Several sub-ops, validated together and applied atomically per device. A batch touching both devices produces two reports.

results.name: ERR_DENIED_BY_POLICY
results.hint: the daemon serves only its own uid

results.name: ERR_BUSY
results.hint: the daemon is momentarily full; retry shortly

results.name: ERR_HANDSHAKE_REQUIRED
results.hint: call uictl_hello() on this connection, then retry

results.name: ERR_KEY_DENYLISTED
results.hint: this key is refused by the daemon and no configuration changes that

results.name: ERR_KEY_NOT_ALLOWED
results.hint: add the keycode to ~/.config/uictl/policy and restart uictld

results.name: ERR_RATE_LIMITED
results.hint: slow down; this is a pacing problem, not a retry problem

results.name: ERR_KEY_ALREADY_HELD
results.hint: reconcile your own held set before retrying

results.name: ERR_KEY_HELD_BY_OTHER
results.hint: another connection is mid-gesture; back off

results.name: ERR_KEY_NOT_HELD
results.hint: reconcile your own held set before retrying

results.name: ERR_TOO_MANY_HELD
results.hint: reconcile your own held set before retrying

results.name: ERR_CONFIRM_UNAVAILABLE
results.hint: no confirmer is connected; run uictl-confirm

results.name: ERR_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT
results.hint: nobody answered; assume the user is away from the keyboard

source_tag_note: ADVISORY. The client writes it, so it MUST NOT be an input to any decision. Its only consumer is the audit log.
